name: Hive 1.5.5
notes: Fixes @hive never answering on a fresh solo install. Two stacked causes: (1) the LOCAL send path had the same cross-device ownership gate as the sync path but without the solo bypass, so after the local identity changed to your GitHub account, a chat created under the old id was silently skipped ('thinking…' with nothing logged); solo workspaces now always answer on the device. (2) With no API key configured, chats defaulted to the hosted 'anthropic' runtime and would 401; the runtime now falls back to the keyless Claude Code CLI (your subscription) whenever a hosted provider has no key, so the agent actually responds out of the box.
